facts.fact: Mozambique's ICT regulator INTIC states that Vodacom Mozambique's Matola data centre, inaugurated on 28 March 2025 to give businesses operating in Mozambique a technology platform, is certified to the Tier III standard.

MOZ.note: Document does not discuss national ID.
Names SEACOM, 2Africa and EASSY only as the data centre's connectivity, not as cables landing in service in the country.
Document does not discuss local government offices.
Document does not state who owns the facility beyond naming Vodacom Mozambique.
